name: Tidewrack Hand
partyAssumption: Four rested characters; fractional CRs are one creature or a small nuisance group, not a solo boss. CR 21+ requires a prepared level 18–20 party with escape routes and tailored terrain.
counter: It can impose Frightened or deal feeding damage only while both it and its target are in water no deeper than 2 feet. Dry ground or deeper water prevents both abilities.
assumptions: Raw damage before attack accuracy, critical hits, saving throws, Resistance, and condition synergies. One legendary attack costing two uses per round if enough other turns occur.
Feeding is active half the rounds for the midpoint scenario; with/without values describe all/none. Extra feeding attacks require targets and cannot accompany a special action.

The baseline uses Multiattack each round. Special actions replace the whole action; evaluate their separately printed damage against one and two targets during playtest. Bonus hunger deals no extra HP damage.
Advantage feedings change hit probability, not listed raw damage, and are recorded separately. Conditional resistance is modeled at half uptime and never changes printed HP.
Healing and secondary fused defensive/movement feedings are not converted into fictional DPR. Stage damage decreases are not included in the opening-phase ceiling.
All active conditions and tethers have their printed duration and ally-assisted counter; innate immunities remain applicable.
